title: The Complexity of Multiplayer Colonel Blotto Games with Player-Specific Values
abstract: arXiv:2609.30019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study equilibrium computation in discrete multiplayer Colonel Blotto games with player-specific battlefield values. In the two-player model with common battlefield values, equilibria can be computed in polynomial time. We show that this tractability breaks down in the multiplayer model with player-specific values under the standard uniform tie-breaking rule. In particular, computing a $(c/n)$-approximate Nash equilibrium is PPAD-hard for some constant $c>0$, even when every player has three resources, where $n$ is the number of players. The main technical step is PPAD-hardness for computing a constant-approximate well-supported Nash equilibrium. In contrast, under uniform tie-breaking, a pure Nash equilibrium can be computed in polynomial time when every player has one resource. translated_title: 具有玩家特定价值的多玩家布洛托上校博弈的复杂性
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有玩家特定战场价值的离散多玩家布洛托上校博弈中的均衡计算问题。在战场价值共同的双人模型中，均衡可以在多项式时间内计算。我们证明，在标准均匀平局裁决规则下，这种可处理性在具有玩家特定价值的多玩家模型中被打破。特别地，对于某个常数 $c>0$，计算 $(c/n)$-近似纳什均衡是PPAD困难的，即使每个玩家拥有三个资源，其中 $n$ 是玩家数量。主要的技术步骤是证明计算常数近似的良支撑纳什均衡的PPAD困难性。相比之下，在均匀平局裁决下，当每个玩家只有一个资源时，纯纳什均衡可以在多项式时间内计算。我们还证明了对于逆指数级小的 $\varepsilon$，计算 $\varepsilon$-近似纳什均衡属于PPAD类。最后，对于非均匀平局裁决规则的情形……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文证明了在玩家拥有各自特定战场价值的多玩家布洛托上校博弈中，即使每个玩家只有三个资源，计算近似纳什均衡也是PPAD困难的，从而揭示了其与双人共同价值情形多项式时间可解性的本质差异。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that computing approximate Nash equilibria in multiplayer Colonel Blotto games with player-specific battlefield values is PPAD-hard even with three resources per player, revealing a fundamental complexity gap from the polynomial-time tractable two-player common-value case.
